entities.name: Toski
entities.description: A small Cosmos monster from Kaldheim, a mischievous squirrel who is the messenger of the gods and serves Esika.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: The god of the World Tree, whom Toski serves.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of the Ten Realms, home of Toski and the Cosmos monsters.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The tree along which Toski scampers to carry messages between the Ten Realms.

entities.name: Ten Realms
entities.description: The realms of Kaldheim between which Toski carries news and messages.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion during which Toski would be compleated.

events.summary: Toski, squirrel messenger of the gods, scampers along the World Tree carrying news and secrets between the Ten Realms to Esika.
events.quote: he scampers with unbelievable speed along the World Tree

events.summary: Toski would be compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Toski would be compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: Toski is a mischievous squirrel who serves Esika
